title: W002 initial Windows PAL rectangle smoke
description: Plan and implement the first executable OxForms vertical slice: VBA emits a minimal display-list command and the Rust PAL renders a rectangle through headless evidence plus a Windows-backed smoke path. Depends on W001 bootstrap and does not claim full UserForm/MSForms parity.

title: Define W002 rectangle smoke plan and acceptance evidence
description: Add the W002 workset/spec plan, name the non-goals, define the first rectangle API/flow, and record the evidence/check shape. Acceptance: docs/worksets/W002_initial_windows_rectangle.md and docs/WORKSET_REGISTER.md agree with the bead graph.

title: Scaffold OxForms Rust/VBA workspace for PAL smoke
description: Create the minimal workspace layout for oxforms-pal, VBA smoke sources, and examples, using the pinned OxVba baseline from docs/SOURCE_REFERENCES.md. Acceptance: cargo metadata/check can inspect the workspace and the placeholder smoke sources are discoverable without relying on a floating sibling checkout.

title: Implement display-list core and headless rectangle renderer
description: Implement the first stable-enough display-list contract with FillRect, color, rectangle geometry, serialization/versioning, and a deterministic headless renderer/hash. Acceptance: a Rust test renders a known rectangle fixture and records a stable diagnostic/hash artifact.

title: Execute VBA rectangle smoke through OxVba and PAL host seam
description: Add a VBA smoke program/class that builds a rectangle display list and sends it through the OxForms PAL host seam under OxVba. This is a procedural/class smoke, not full .frm/UserForm integration. Acceptance: the OxVba-driven smoke produces the same display-list/render diagnostic as the Rust fixture.

title: Add Windows visible rectangle smoke backend
description: Add the smallest Windows-backed surface or demo that paints the same display list into a visible window when run on Windows, while keeping headless rendering as the CI-safe oracle. Acceptance: a Windows manual or ignored smoke command opens/paints/closes deterministically, and non-Windows runs report an explicit unsupported diagnostic.

title: Record rectangle smoke evidence and fresh-eyes review
description: Record the W002 artifacts, hashes, commands, platform notes, and fresh-eyes review. Acceptance: evidence docs link the Rust fixture, OxVba smoke, and Windows smoke result or blocker, and the workset closure condition is objectively checkable.
